show.description: When Princess Ananya Suryavanshi is betrayed and reborn, destiny gives her a second chance — to rewrite her fate and uncover the truth about the mysterious “beggar” she marries, Prithvi, who hides a royal secret. As greed, power, and vengeance drive her sister Radhika to ruin, Ananya rises from ashes — from Fakir’s wife to Sultan’s queen.
